text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a research paper focused on land use/cover (LULC) prediction for the entire country of Romania, explicitly at the national scale subdivided into Development Regions. The study uses the CLUE-S spatially explicit model to simulate future agricultural land use changes from 2007 to 2050 under two scenarios, based on past change rates (1990-2000 and 2000-2006). It includes quantitative comparison of ≥2 future scenarios, provides mapped LULC projections, and reports quantitative accuracy metrics (Overall Accuracy, Kappa index, Producer’s and User’s accuracy). The study’s primary objective is LULC prediction/simulation (agricultural land use flows) with spatial modeling and validation. It does not meet any exclusion criteria such as being local/regional only, purely historical, methodological without application, or lacking future scenarios. Therefore, it meets all core inclusion criteria for a national-scale spatial LULC prediction study.)
